correctness.rationale: For RZZY generators \(P_e=Z_iZ_jY_k\), every shared vertex with unequal local Pauli roles contributes exactly one anticommutation sign, so \(P_eP_f=(-1)^mP_fP_e\). This immediately proves invariance under swaps of even-mismatch pairs. Both star families have zero mismatches pairwise. The two-edge chain has one mismatch; direct expansion on \(|+\rangle^{\otimes4}\) gives overlap \(1-2\sin^2(a)\sin^2(b)\). Boundary cases with zero sine are stated as exceptional rather than used to claim generic order sensitivity.
